# ankra_organisation_variable (Resource)

An organisation variable, referenced from stack manifests and add-on values as `${{ ankra.<name> }}`. The counterpart of `ankra org variables set` and `ankra org variables delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_organisation_variable" "region" {
  name        = "default_region"
  value       = "fsn1"
  description = "Region new clusters default to"
}

resource "ankra_organisation_variable" "registry_password" {
  name      = "registry_password"
  value     = var.registry_password
  is_secret = true
}

variable "registry_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Variable name. Changing it replaces the variable.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value. For a secret variable the platform never returns the value, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `is_secret` (Boolean) Whether the value is a secret: hidden from listings and only revealed to members with write access. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the variable.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Organisation variables are imported by name.
terraform import ankra_organisation_variable.region default_region
```
